title: New Moon, Blank Page
skyStory: The new moon arrives in Aquarius, three percent lit and basically invisible, like a page fresh out of the package. Uranus hands it a fountain pen. The sky holds its breath. Whatever gets written tonight becomes the first sentence of a whole new chapter, so the stars are leaning in close, hoping it is something with a good opening line and maybe a dragon.

reading: Ten things are tugging at your sleeve, and the new moon only has room for one. The [[Knight of Wands]] is pacing beside you with a torch, asking which way to aim. You know the answer already. You knew it in the shower this morning. Say it out loud.

Write that one thing on a fresh page. Not a list. One line. Then tuck the page somewhere you will forget about it until the full moon on your birthday. When it comes back around, you will be surprised how far the Tiger carried it. Fire is fastest when it has one log to burn, not ten. Feed one log tonight.
joel.mission: Write a single sentence about the one thing you want this month and hide the page inside a book until March 21.
joel.omen: A candle or burner flame that leans one way. It means your chosen direction has the wind behind it.

reading: The tide is out under this dark moon, and the beach is all fresh sand and possibility. The shore is ready for new footprints. Yours have a destination in mind; you have been walking toward it for a while, steady as the mountain, quiet as the snow.

Tonight, write down the next small step, not the whole map. One stone to step on. The [[Six of Swords]] reminds you the crossing is still underway, and that the boat moves best with a clear point on the far shore. Pick the point. Joel is rowing too, even when you cannot see the oar. The water carries both of you.
nancy.mission: Draw a tiny map with just two dots on it: where you are and where you are heading next, then stick it somewhere secret.
nancy.omen: Footprints in fresh snow or mud going the same direction as you. It means someone has already cleared part of your path.

together.text: Under the new moon, swap your one-line intentions for the month. Do not comment. Do not advise. Just reply with a single flame emoji to say I saw it and I am holding it too. Check back on the full moon.
